subject: Edge tenancy separation & renewal coordination
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@vanguardbio.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@vanguardbio.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Edge tenancy separation and term renewal - upcoming cycle

Hi Soojin,

We're entering our renewal window for our Private deployment on April 1 and we want to discuss expanding to two additional edge sites and tightening tenancy isolation for regulated workloads. High-level asks from our side: 
- Provision two new on-prem satellite nodes (NY and Frankfurt) with strict tenant isolation (no cross-tenant KV sharing)
- Extend committed term to 36 months across the Private footprint in exchange for reduced unit pricing
- Bring-your-own-key (KMS) support for the new sites and updated audit log retention to 7 years

Can you share what lead times look like for new site onboarding, a rough uplift in reserved capacity, and any impact to SLA or failover behavior? Procurement also wants a timeline to get an internal PO out by 10 March if we can agree commercial terms.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Platform Ops
VanguardBio

Attachment: requirements_summary.pdf (referenced)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@vanguardbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge tenancy separation and term renewal - upcoming cycle

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear summary. We're excited to help VanguardBio scale the Private footprint. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

1) Lead time & provisioning
- Typical edge site onboarding (procure, image, validate) is 6–8 weeks once we have the site acceptance checklist completed. Frankfurt may add an extra 5–7 business days for regional compliance checks.

2) Isolation & KMS
- We can configure strict tenant isolation (separate Kubernetes namespaces + enforced KV isolation). BYOK is supported via our KMS integration; we'll need the key material and an HSM/rotation plan for each site.

3) Commercials & term
- Ben (copied) will draft a commercial summary with uplift estimates for +2 sites and a 36-month term credit profile.

4) Action plan
- I'll schedule a 30-minute scoping call with Platform Ops, our Solutions Engineer (Lauren), and Commercial (Ben) to run through the SOW assumptions and timeline.
- I'll attach an initial capacity workbook and the security checklist to capture the technical inputs you referenced.

Can you confirm availability for a scoping call this week or next? If Procurement needs the PO by 10 March, we should fast-track the commercial preview next week.

Best,
Soojin Lee 
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial_capacity_workbook.xlsx, security_checklist.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@vanguardbio.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge tenancy separation and term renewal - upcoming cycle (commercial summary)

Daniel / team — putting quick commercial context on the table so we can align procurement expectations: 

- Deal: RDW-2317-VB (VanguardBio) — expansion + term extension
- Scope: +2 on-prem satellite nodes (NY, Frankfurt), strict tenant isolation, BYOK at site level, 7-year audit retention
- Preliminary pricing delta: ~+28% OPEX on hosted baseline for the two sites, with a 9% blended credit if VanguardBio commits to 36 months across the Private footprint (details in attached commercial_summary_v1.pdf).
- SLA: standard Dedicated SLA applies per-site; for isolated tenancy we can offer a 99.9% availability objective with targeted response SLAs during business hours.

Next steps I propose: 
1) 30-min scoping call (SLA, KMS, activation windows)
2) Draft SOW & SOW redlines (Monica to lead)
3) Procurement-ready commercial sheet by 22 Feb so you have time to route internally for PO by 10 Mar.

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (deal record)

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: commercial_summary_v1.pdf

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@vanguardbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge tenancy separation and term renewal - upcoming cycle

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Ben & Soojin. A few follow-ups from Procurement/IT before we lock dates: 

- Data residency: For Frankfurt site the data plane must remain in EU and any failover that would replicate PII must be explicit opt-in. Please confirm we can restrict cross-region replication for that tenant.
- SLA & support hours: our Security team requires 24/7 incident support for any site hosting regulated workloads. Can you confirm an operational model for that and any cost delta?
- SOC2 + Artifact access: Procurement needs SOC2 Type II report and evidence that audit logs can be exported to our SIEM; ideally a short procedure doc we can attach to the PO.

If we can get the procurement-ready commercial by COB 2/24 and the SOC2 artifact, we can move to an internal approval and target a PO issuance by 10 Mar.

On availability for the scoping call: Wed 2/24 10:00–11:00 EST works for Daniel and me.

Best,
Asha Rao
Head of IT Operations, VanguardBio

Quoted earlier message:
> On Tue, 16 Feb 2027 at 09:12 AM Daniel Park <daniel.park@vanguardbio.com> wrote:
> > We're entering our renewal window for our Private deployment on April 1 and we want to discuss expanding to two additional edge sites and tightening tenancy isolation for regulated workloads.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@vanguardbio.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@vanguardbio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edge tenancy separation and term renewal - upcoming cycle (MAP & next steps)

Hi Asha / Daniel — thanks, this is useful. Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) and an updated SOW (RDW_SOW_VanguardBio_v2.docx) that incorporates: 

- Explicit EU-only data residency for the Frankfurt tenant and opt-in failover controls
- BYOK instructions and KMS onboarding checklist (page 3)
- 24/7 incident response option (add-on) with associated cost delta called out in Appendix B
- Audit log export procedure for SIEM integration (we will provide a step-by-step runbook and a SOC2 artifact export)

Proposed timeline (high level):
- 3/3–3/10: Finalize commercial redlines (Ben) and legal terms
- 3/11: Procurement sign-off target
- 3/15–4/30: Staged provisioning and validation for NY & Frankfurt (Frankfurt validation may require regulatory review)

I've scheduled the scoping/contract review on Wed 2/24 at 10:00–10:30 EST per your note and included the calendar invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Please review the attached MAP and SOW; Ben will follow up with the procurement-ready commercial sheet. If Procurement needs the SOC2 artifact sooner, we can share the report under NDA — let me know and I'll push it to you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_SOW_VanguardBio_v2.docx, mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf
